description: Most recent weekly NASS crop progress for corn, soybeans, or wheat — the share of the crop at each growth stage (planted, emerged, silking, harvested, and similar; the stages present vary by commodity) — from USDA NASS QuickStats. Use for current season pace; use get_crop_progress_history instead for week-by-week pace across the season, and get_crop_condition for health ratings. Read-only lookup of stored statistics; no API key. Progress is published weekly in season, but the stored copy refreshes weekly; the returned `period` (e.g. 2026-W30) is the freshest stored week.

geography.description: US for national, or state code (IA, IL, etc.); state coverage is the major corn-belt states. Default: US

name: get_crop_progress
